scope: Four exact captured XML/JSON CMS configurations; bounded production-session method calls and byte-identical offline HTTP replay. Not all CMS sources or Android/ART parity.
authority: Pinned TVBoxOS ab11d289e09963a9daf65ca7f6b7a9a8cbe184e1 HTTP branches and original JSON model conversions; XML uses explicit secured DOM binding, not XStream.
playbackScope: Metadata only, no media bytes, player/decoder/transcoder or external parse provider tested.
searchScope: Two search signatures are exercised; baseline CMS search ignores page/quick flags, so this is not two search pages.

offlineDoctor.scope: Offline owned HTTP fixtures; actual subscription dispatch, parsers, request parameters, player metadata and cleanup; no media request

limitations: Live errors and empty parent categories are retained; supplemental category IDs come from actual recommendation rows and the original class list.
XML external entities/DOCTYPE/XInclude are disabled; general XStream equivalence and Android UI/cache async behavior remain unverified.
Node HTTP transport does not implement Android hosts/proxy/DOH/cookie/client state.
Local loopback /file/ ext has no implicitly bound NAS storage root.
JAR compatibility remains paused; old full-JAR matrix belongs to the retained base image, not this new CMS image.
